sections.label: A
sections.suggestion: Use as hook: add drums, bass and a wider lead/pad layer.

instrumentation: Add a simple electric bass or synth bass layer to anchor the low end.
Use piano, clean guitar, or warm pad for the main harmonic body.
Add a small top-line counter melody after the first section.
Keep lead and pad material close to C major for a coherent first pass.
arrangement: Start with a half-time drum groove around 152 BPM, then vary hats between sections.
Use the first chord loop as the harmonic motif: C - C5.
Treat section A as the hook or chorus and widen the stereo image there.
Keep velocity variation; it is in a usable range for expressive playback.
warnings: Key confidence is low because the pitch-class distribution is ambiguous.
